title: [observability] When free disk gains, Core lines says "Free disk gained a day" (and "Store that shrank least" when every store shrank), each size positive; positive values as before (rev-j's report: "lost -2662.8 MB a day")
prompt:
Spawn, objective 230 [observability] (the lead's YES of 2026-11-19 11:4x on rev-e's scope, grew_most folded in; conditions: a scenario case for each sign on both figures, positive values rendered byte-identical to today, mutants for a sign flip and a missing abs; author rev-e; readers rev-j, then rev-k; from rev-j's report via rev-g): when free disk gains, Core lines says "gained", and when every store shrank, "shrank least", each with the size as a positive number.

Base: live main ca482ad5 (227's src).

The problem: the Fleet page's storage diagnostics (web/src/coreLines.ts mark(), read by the Core lines card and the health strip's DiagnosticRows) write a figure's name and unitWords(value). storage.disk_fall is named "Free disk lost a day" and goes below zero when the disk gains (222's fit or day): the page read "Free disk lost a day (the week's fit)" beside "-2662.8 MB a day". storage.grew_most ("Store that grew most: <store>") is below zero when every store shrank (since 222 R2 it is the week's fit less the measured parts, so "unattributed" is below zero whenever the fit is and no part is measured): "Store that grew most: unattributed" beside a negative size.

Read first: web/src/coreLines.ts (mark, basisWords, unitWords); web/test/coreLines.test.ts (objective 225's test); rsi/scenarios/225.sh (how an answer is read through coreLinesView under node).

What changes (web/src and web/test only; no server change, the answer is unchanged):
(1) mark(): for key storage.disk_fall with a value below zero, the name's " lost " becomes " gained " ("Free disk gained a day"), and the value is said for |value| ("2662.8 MB a day"); for key storage.grew_most below zero, the name's " grew most" becomes " shrank least" ("Store that shrank least: unattributed"), |value|.
(2) basisWords: for a disk that gained, "day" says " (over the last day)" (never "fall" for a gain); "fit" stays " (the week's fit)"; a figure that did not gain says what it said.
(3) At zero and above, and for every other figure (any key, any sign), every mark is as it was: name, value, range and tone. The range and the tone of a turned figure are as they were.

What stays as it is: the server, GET /api/core-lines, every other figure and page, the trend, and both figures at zero or above.

Files: web/src/coreLines.ts, web/test/coreLines.test.ts; owner: rsi/scenarios/230.sh, rsi/backlog/230.json.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/230.sh, black box on its own database, through GET /api/core-lines of a real spawn serve, with hourly host.core_lines samples planted as 222.sh and 225.sh plant them, each answer read through web/src/coreLines.ts's coreLinesView under node as the page does:
- (1) a week gaining 5 GB a day up to F - 20 GB a day ago, then 20 GB through the last day (disk_fall below zero, basis "fit"; grew_most below zero, unattributed): "Free disk gained a day (the week's fit)" with unitWords(|value|), no minus; "Store that shrank least: unattributed" with unitWords(|value|);
- (2) a week gaining 20 GB a day up to F - 5 GB a day ago, then 5 GB (basis "day"): "Free disk gained a day (over the last day)", |value|; the store that shrank least, |value|;
- (3) a week and a day falling 10 GB a day (both above zero): "Free disk lost a day" with the answer's basis words as before, "Store that grew most: unattributed", each value unitWords(value) as before;
- (4) in each, every other figure (each raw figure paired with its mark, coreLinesView's own mapping) says neither "gained" nor "shrank least".
The answer's signs and basis per world are checked first (a harness fault otherwise). On live main ca482ad5, 230.sh exits 1.

Tests (unit, web/test/coreLines.test.ts): disk_fall below zero under each basis and none (gained, |value|, no minus); above zero and at zero as before; grew_most below zero (shrank least, |value|) and above zero as before; another figure below zero as before. No test is renamed or dropped.

Verified by: after landing, on live, while storage.disk_fall is below zero, the Fleet page's diagnostics say "Free disk gained a day …" with a positive size (the lead's look, with /api/core-lines at the same minute).
